content:
[Intro]
[D5]

[Verse 1]
We pass in hall
on our way to separate rooms
Only time we'll ever talk
is when the monthly bills are due

[Pre-Chorus]
[G5]We go to work, we go
to church We fake a perfect life
[D5]
I passed
[G5]the point of giving a damn
All my tears are
[A5]cried
We can just go

[Chorus]
[D]on like this
Or say the word, we'll
[G5]call it quits
Baby, you can go
[A5]or you can stay
[G5]
But I won't love you either way

[Interlude]
[D5]

[Verse 2]
It's been so long since I've felt
Anything inside these walls
You can't heal, you can't hurt?
When you don't feel at all

[Pre-Chorus]
[G5]I used to cry and stay
up nights And wonder what went wrong
[D5]
[G5]It's been hard But hearts
can only do that for so long
[A5]
We can just go

[Chorus]
[D]on like this
Or say the word, we'll
[G5]call it quits
Baby, you can go
[A5]or you can stay
[G5]
But I won't love you either way

[Bridge]
[D5]
[G5]
[A5]
We can just go

[Chorus]
[D]on like this
Or say the word, we'll
[G5]call it quits
Baby, you can go
[A5]or you can stay
[G5]
But I won't love you either way

[Outro]
[D5]
title: Either Way
tuning: D A D G B E
